description: Read-only balance aggregation across every configured EVM chain plus Solana, Bitcoin, and Hyperliquid. Reports native assets, supported token/collectible reads, failed or missing providers, unverified assets, timestamps, and known priced value without pretending it is a complete total. Public addresses only; never signs or broadcasts.

addresses.description: Optional public wallet addresses by family. Omit configured families to use ORACLE_*_ADDRESS defaults.

evmChainIds.description: Optional EVM chain subset. Default is every configured EVM chain.

includeCollectibles.description: Include supported collectible reads. Default true.

includePrices.description: Fetch current DeFiLlama native prices. Default true.

includeTokens.description: Include supported token reads. Default true.

name: portfolio_balance
